policy: This split is prospective only. The current three model controls consumed all4320 records during optimization, so this development partition is not independent evidence for them. A future candidate must use training_conditioning only for optimization and this development_conditioning only for preregistered threshold selection; protected final sets remain closed. Shared source/TTS family limitations remain and this is synthetic-only.
threshold_policy: Select one event threshold/policy before opening any protected acceptance material; report target, confusion, complete-background events and one-sided Poisson bound. No threshold reuse across changed model/decoder.
